title: Pure iron pillar of Delhi

tellings.quote: and they still stand. Or take the pillar in the center of Delhi in India.

plain: Kiran Ilum Xenov is a former president of one of Russia's republics who says aliens took him in 1997. He points to the pillar of pure iron in the centre of Delhi, India, as an ancient work that still stands. He tells Michels this alongside other old structures that "still stand," naming no source, as an example of something from the distant past that has lasted.
